en_title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Lucia Actress Finally Revealed — And Yes, It's Who You Probably Suspected
cn_title: 《GTA6》Lucia的扮演者终于揭晓——没错，就是你可能猜到的那个人
opus_summary: 《GTA6》主角Lucia Caminos的扮演者确认为Manni L. Perez，消息来自The Game Awards提名直播。目前Jason Duval的扮演者仍未揭晓，Rockstar也尚未正式公布游戏配音阵容。《GTA6》将于11月18日发售。

paragraphs.en: On the eve of launching GTA 6 , we finally now know who portrays main character Lucia Caminos.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA6》发售前夕，我们终于知道了主角Lucia Caminos的扮演者是谁。

paragraphs.en: Today's big reveal came via a blink-and-you'll miss it moment during The Game Awards' nominations livestream, where Manni L. Perez was nominated for her role in GTA 6. Unfortunately, we still don't know who is playing her co-star Jason Duval, as his actor did not get nominated. Ouch.
paragraphs.cn: 今天这个重大消息是在The Game Awards提名名单直播中稍纵即逝的一刻揭晓的：Manni L. Perez凭借在《GTA6》中的角色获得了提名。遗憾的是，我们仍不知道与她搭档的Jason Duval由谁扮演，因为他的演员没有获得提名。真扎心。

paragraphs.en: The announcement comes after months of speculation around who is bringing Grand Theft Auto's first ever playable couple to life, and some very careful social media livestreams from the long-rumored Lucia actress where Perez dodged constant comments about her part in perhaps the most anticipated video game of all time.
paragraphs.cn: 在这一消息公布之前，外界数月来一直在猜测是谁赋予了《侠盗猎车手》系列首对可操作情侣生命。而长期被传是Lucia扮演者的Perez也曾在社交媒体直播中十分谨慎地回避不断出现的评论，这些评论都在询问她是否参演了这款或许是有史以来最受期待的电子游戏。

paragraphs.en: Somewhat incredibly, Rockstar is still to officially announce GTA 6's voice cast — and the only reason we're getting the confirmation of Perez today is because of her award nomination.
paragraphs.cn: 有些不可思议的是，Rockstar至今仍未正式公布《GTA6》的配音演员阵容——而我们今天之所以能确认Perez参演，仅仅是因为她获得了奖项提名。

paragraphs.en: Perez is an actress with a smattering of credits to her acting resume, including TV guest roles in Jessica Jones, Chicago P.D. and Law & Order: Special Victims Unit. While she hasn't been up to much else over the past few years, it's perhaps easy to now know why — it's likely she has been kept very busy working GTA 6 instead.
paragraphs.cn: Perez的演艺履历中有少量作品，包括在电视剧《杰西卡·琼斯》《芝加哥警署》和《法律与秩序：特殊受害者》中客串。虽然她过去几年没有参与太多其他作品，但现在或许不难理解原因——她很可能一直忙于《GTA6》的工作。

paragraphs.en: Fun fact: this won't actually be Perez's first GTA role. In GTA 5, Perez portrays the background character of "Clubber #2", while in GTA Online she voices a blackjack dealer.
paragraphs.cn: 一个有趣的事实：这其实不是Perez第一次在《GTA》系列中扮演角色。在《GTA5》中，Perez扮演了一名叫作「夜店客人2号」的背景角色；在《GTA Online》中，她则为一名二十一点荷官配音。

paragraphs.en: Last month, the actors behind GTA 5's Franklin, Michael, and Trevor shared their advice for GTA 6's cast in a bid to ready them for the kind of fame few video game actors achieve.
paragraphs.cn: 上个月，《GTA5》中Franklin、Michael和Trevor的扮演者向《GTA6》的演员们分享了建议，希望帮助他们为少有电子游戏演员能获得的那种名气做好准备。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 officially launches tomorrow — yes, tomorrow — on November 18.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》将于明天——没错，就是明天——11月18日正式发售。
